g.text: Would you feel comfortable discussing flying to conferences with your group?
Do you consider flying to conferences as vital to your academic career?
In the past, did you ever not attend a conference because you had to fly?
Do you think you have control over what conferences you attend?
Do you consider flying to conferences a problem or benefit of working in academia?
Do you consider the climate crisis a pressing problem of our society?
Do you think your individual behavior can have an impact on the climate crisis?
